title: @retrojb/ui component spec
description: One component's entry in the component index. One file per exported component, named <Name>Spec.yaml and kept in the component's folder. All paths are relative to the repository root. Change history is not stored here: it lives in changesets and packages/ui/CHANGELOG.md.

specVersion.description: Version of this file format. Bump when the schema changes shape.

id.description: Stable camelCase identifier: the exported name with a lower-case first letter. Other specs reference this in usage.composes and usage.alternatives.

name.description: The exported component name, exactly as in packages/ui/src/index.ts. Must match the file name: <name>Spec.yaml.

subcategory.description: Second-level grouping, where one exists (typography: body, headings).

status.description: planned: empty scaffold. stub: markup but not exported. experimental: exported, API may change without a major bump. shipped: exported and stable. deprecated: still exported, scheduled for removal.

complexity.description: Atomic design level. atom: one element. molecule: a few parts working together. organism: a section built from molecules.

description.description: One or two sentences: what the component is for, and the one thing a caller is most likely to get wrong.

files.description: Where each artifact lives, relative to the repo root. null means it does not exist yet. The CI check fails when a non-null path is missing.

exports.description: Everything this component contributes to the package's public surface, plus internals worth knowing about.

internal.description: true when the symbol is not exported from @retrojb/ui.

api.description: The props a caller has to know about. Not every native attribute.

extends.description: The native props type the component spreads, e.g. ComponentPropsWithRef<'button'>.

props.description: Non-variant props with a fixed set of values.

defaults.description: Native props the component overrides the default of, e.g. type: button.

parts.description: Props for each compound part, keyed by the part's export name.

element.description: The rendered root element, or a union when `as` changes it.

role.description: The ARIA role, implicit or explicit.

pattern.description: The WAI-ARIA APG pattern followed, if any.

wcag.description: WCAG 2.2 success criteria the implementation addresses.

standalone.description: false when the component only makes sense inside a parent, e.g. Radio inside RadioGroup.

composes.description: ids of the components this one renders. usedBy is derived from these, so it is not stored.

nativeElement.description: true when the component renders the native element for its role rather than an ARIA re-implementation.

alternatives.description: Components to use instead, and when.

tokens.description: Semantic design tokens the styles use, without the utility prefix (accent, not bg-accent).

versioning.description: Lifecycle markers only. Per-change history comes from changesets: name the component in the changeset summary and it shows up in packages/ui/CHANGELOG.md.

figma.description: Figma linkage. Only syncedWith for now; node ids and edit history come later.

syncedWith.description: The @retrojb/ui version the Figma component was last checked against. null when it has never been checked.

values.description: The allowed literal values, for a prop with a fixed set. Use `type` instead for a prop that takes any value of a type.

type.description: The TypeScript type, for a prop that is not a fixed set of values: string, ReactNode, string[], (value: string) => void. Give exactly one of `values` or `type`.
